record.motion: Clarify ownership and systems for attendance and engagement data used in student success interventions
record.segment: Public research university; 30,000–39,999 enrollment band; Southeast United States
facts_carried_over: Patrick D. Dempsey is Executive Director, Academic Support & Student Learning and oversees Supplemental Instruction, peer tutoring, Science Learning Center, and eSuccess programs. Source: Florida Atlantic University CLASS contact page; source date: 2026-09-01 (page crawled).
Florida Atlantic University reported total Fall 2025 enrollment of 32,248. Source: Florida Atlantic University 2025-2026 University Catalog introduction; source date: 2026-09-01 (page crawled).

FAU's Success Network is powered by EAB Navigate and connects students with advisors, faculty, tutors, and support staff. Source: Florida Atlantic University Success Network page; source date: 2026-08-01 (page crawled).

FAU's 2022-2023 OIT annual report says Navigate had daily integrations with Canvas and Banner and replaced Starfish and Civitas. Source: Florida Atlantic University OIT annual report; source date: 2023-10-01.

Student Affairs uses Owl Central to track co-curricular engagement and Baseline for assessment; the Office of Assessment and Research manages the assessment cycle. Source: Florida Atlantic University Student Affairs Assessment Cycle page; source date: 2026-08-01 (page crawled).

CLASS currently schedules tutoring through TracCloud, while Supplemental Instruction continuation is informed by session attendance and DFW rates. Sources: Florida Atlantic University tutoring instructions and CLASS faculty page; source dates: 2025-03-01 and 2026-09-01 (page crawled).

Jessica Meith is Director, Student Success Management; James Capp is Senior Associate Vice President, Strategic Planning and Student Success; Jason Ball is Associate Vice President, Information Technology and Chief Information Officer. Source: Florida Atlantic University Provost office staff page; source date: 2026-09-02 (page crawled).
not_verified: No public source identified a single institutional owner for all attendance and engagement data used in student success interventions.
Current technical data flow among TracCloud, EAB Navigate, Canvas, Banner, Owl Central, Baseline, and any data warehouse is not publicly documented.
Whether Patrick D. Dempsey can initiate or sponsor an enterprise attendance-data purchase is unknown.
Patrick D. Dempsey's direct reporting line is not publicly verified.
No internal context available; prior contact history and existing account notes remain unchecked.
constraints: Motion was unclear and treated as a hypothesis
One contact, one institution, one outreach draft
record.what_this_suggests: Use Patrick as an operational discovery contact for academic-support attendance, but confirm ownership with Student Success Management and Information Technology before positioning an institution-wide attendance or engagement data solution.
